items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: The drummer's name was Eugene Holland. ... I went to see them, so this guy, this drummer he fascinated me

ctx.x: His name was Eugene Holland. Eugene Holland, but his professional name was Peggy. They called him Peggy Holland. Oh, man, he was a -- he was picture. He, so anyway, I did this job with this band, was six white boys and me. Only colored. Now you know I stand out like obvious.

I'm the only soul brother in between all them days. so now we get a gig. We start playing the basketball games and the local dances, all that stuff, but I'm still 15 years old. I couldn't go on a gig in Newark, New Jersey or East Orange, or places like that, big affairs. We had a manager of the band, him and his wife, because we were all kids, they used to chaperone us, you know.
